# Project Context

Project rules and assigned data connections provide scoped context for workflow
agents. Update them through the project configuration screens. Edit Project rules
on the Policy tab and use Save Project; the execution policy has its own Save
policy button. Inspect Jobs for execution evidence: logs, messages, events,
approvals, outputs, and artifacts.

## Current public surfaces

The former project Knowledge Base page and MCP contracts `kb_search`, `kb_write`,
`project_profile_get`, and `project_profile_update` are not exposed by the current
public UI or MCP source on main. Use `project_list` for project discovery and
workflow/job tools for workflow contracts and execution evidence. The source
retains internal cleanup for legacy built-in KB tool records and project-profile
synchronization into canonical memory; these do not provide a public KB editor or
memory CRUD contract. These statements describe the reviewed source on main;
availability in a published release has not been verified.

The reviewed core public source exposes no contract for repository code indexing,
code search or graphs, schema-index snapshots, project reindex controls, or
application-code generation. An external tool's declared abilities do not
establish those core capabilities. This page keeps its historical URL so existing
links explain the current scope.

## Internal memory

The application still maintains canonical memory and workflow knowledge used by
runtime context assembly and deterministic workflow discovery. Project-profile
synchronization uses stable account/project IDs and includes project rules plus
assigned connection metadata. The synchronized profile includes at most the first
2,000 characters of project rules. Exact project-profile retrieval does not fall
back to another account or project.

Internal storage and retrieval services are not a public knowledge-management
feature. Dataset introspection and scoped queries remain separate supported
features; see [Datasets And Data Connections](../user/datasets-and-data-connections).

See [MCP Reference](../reference/mcp),
[Workspaces And Projects](../user/workspaces-and-projects), and
[Jobs And Approvals](../user/jobs-and-approvals).
